Plugin.Name: THERMALRIGHT DIGITAL
Plugin.Overview: Control a Thermalright Peerless Assassin 140 Digital USB display (0416:8001) from Unraid Settings. Show host CPU temperature, load, watts and MHz, with configurable RGB effects and temperature colors for selected display categories. Includes weekly display-off scheduling with overnight intervals or entire days in the server timezone. Requires Docker and a started array. The driver runs in an isolated container with access to one USB device. CPU power requires a supported hwmon or RAPL source; GPU metrics are not provided. Hardware confirmed on Unraid 7.3.4 with the LF12 profile; other supported layouts require hardware validation. Community project, unaffiliated with Thermalright or Unraid.
